title: Pattern-Driven Evaluation of LLM Code Optimization: Isolating Compiler-Transcendent Semantic Reasoning
title_zh: 基于模式的大模型代码优化评估：分离超越编译器的语义推理

paragraphs.en: 总结：本文提出PatternBench基准，用于评估大模型超越编译器的代码优化能力，结合运行时加速与AST忠实性分析揭示现有评测的不足。 Existing evaluations of LLM-based code optimization primarily measure end-to-end speedup, obscuring whether a model actually performs the intended optimization. For compiled languages, this is especially problematic: observed gains may reflect transformations already recoverable by modern optimizing compilers rather than optimization behavior attributable to the model itself. We present PatternBench, a benchmark for studying compiler-transcendent optimization, i.e., performance improvements that remain after aggressive compiler optimization. PatternBench targets residual optimization opportunities across seven classes of transformations and pairs runtime evaluation with an AST-based optimization faithfulness analysis that verifies whether the intended optimization is realized in the generated program. Experiments with frontier, open-weight, and fine-tuned models show that runtime speedup alone provides an incomplete account of optimization capability. Optimization faithfulness is strongly associated with realized speedup, and fine-tuning improves both faithfulness and optimization effectiveness. These results suggest that evaluation of LLM-based code optimization should measure not only performance outcomes, but also whether the target transformation was successfully executed.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：本文提出PatternBench基准，用于评估大模型超越编译器的代码优化能力，结合运行时加速与AST忠实性分析揭示现有评测的不足。现有的基于大模型的代码优化评测主要衡量端到端加速比，从而掩盖了模型是否真正执行了预期的优化。 对于编译型语言而言，这一问题尤为突出：观测到的性能提升可能反映了现代优化编译器本就能恢复的变换，而非可归因于模型自身的优化行为。 我们提出PatternBench，一个用于研究超越编译器的优化的基准，即在激进的编译器优化之后仍然保留的性能提升。 PatternBench针对七类变换中的残留优化机会，并将运行时评估与基于AST的优化忠实性分析相结合，以验证预期的优化是否在生成的程序中真正实现。 对前沿模型、开放权重模型和微调模型的实验表明，仅凭运行时加速无法完整刻画优化能力。 优化忠实性与实际加速比密切相关，而微调能够同时提升忠实性和优化有效性。 这些结果表明，对基于大模型的代码优化的评测不仅应衡量性能结果，还应衡量目标变换是否被成功执行。
